conclusion: Use the measured ordinary arm64 AOT local-test APK for local acceptance. Stable same-source comparison found Debug-specific first-launch extraction and longer startup; no persistent native/business startup blocker was demonstrated, and no speculative product code optimization was made.
method: One task AVD, existing Android 35 arm64 image, system boot completed before sampling; same frozen source; three force-stop cold process launches per mode. First sample follows fresh install. OS filesystem caches were not dropped. ActivityTaskManager Displayed / am start -W used for TTID.

extraction.release: No ResourceExtractor or kernel/snapshot extraction lines in three trials.

interpretation: The 286ms log span is extraction log interval, not total Debug runtime cost.
Prior new-AVD/Debug timeout at 12.7s was an uncontrolled busy-start observation and eventually displayed onboarding. A command timeout is not established as the root cause.
Current stable six launches all returned Status ok with first screen evidence.
Emulator timing is not representative of production physical-device performance. Fully drawn appears in ActivityTaskManager logs but no new product reportFullyDrawn instrumentation was added.

finalPackage.reproducibleBuild: flutter_app/tool/build_android_local.sh (root executed; identical hash to measured AOT package)
finalPackage.signature: Existing local Android Debug keystore; local-test only, not production release signing.
